notes.title: Announcement of Hard Mode Addition
notes.content:
[h2]1. Added Hard Mode "Seven Deadly Sins"[/h2]

In Hard Mode, the game starts with special mutations.
Select "New Game" with data that has cleared Ending A.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447597/03085c48e11e778541b232d134fbb3e833f44024.png[/img]

Initially, you can select only one mutation.
As you reach Ending A with the maximum number of selectable mutations, the number of selectable mutations increases.

Aim to clear the game with all 7 mutations!

[h2]2. Adjusted Game Balance[/h2]
[h3]a. Card Adjustments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447597/ac9394c9cab59515d198b74a1bbd7ee59df90714.png[/img]

[b]【Protect Wall】[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed damage reduction from 8 to 10.
[/list]
[b]【Thorny Thorn】【Crystal Thorn】[/b]
[list]
[*] No longer consume a turn when used.
[/list]
[b]【Quick Work】[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed effect from "Redraw without consuming a turn" to "Discard hand, then draw the same number of cards."
[/list]
[b]【Burst Arrow】[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed power from 4 to 5.
[/list]
[b]【Atone Arrow】[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed power from 4 to 3.
[*] Additional effect power increase also changed from 4 to 3.
[/list]
[b]【Follow-through】[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed power from 4 to 3.
[*] Changed Pure increase from 2 to 1.
[*] Changed range from 2 to 3.
[*] Changed effect from "Draw 1 card if this card kills an enemy" to "+1 Mental Strength if enemy defeated."
[/list]

[h3]b. Mutation Adjustments[/h3]

[b]【Carnivore】[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed meat recovery increase value from 8 to 5.
[*] Changed meat Karma increase value from 10 to 4.
[/list]
[b]【Poison Touch】[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed meat recovery decrease value from 5 to 3.
[/list]

[h3]c. Enemy Status Adjustments[/h3]

[b]【Imp】[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed HP from 13 to 12.
[*] Changed attack power from 7 to 6.
[/list]
[b]【Shade】[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed HP from 15 to 14.
[/list]
[b]【Ghoul】[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed attack power from 7 to 6.
[/list]

[h2]3. Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Result screen now displays upon clearing.
[*] Removed Fallen Angel card "Full Burst."
[*] Added Fallen Angel card "Samsara."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41447597/22921cbadfda8eca09bf4e0b99e9d95ff09323d9.png[/img]
[*] Changed Mental Strength mechanic.
　Mental Strength now halves instead of resetting to 0 when ascending stairs.
　Set the maximum Willpower value to 9.
[*] "Purity Arrow" and "Holy Shot" effects will not activate when Karma is 0.
[/list]

notes.title: Regarding Known Issues
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Lazriel: The Demon's Fall."
In this notice, I will list the known issues that have been reported.

[h3]■ Known Issues ------------------------[/h3]
The following issues are currently under investigation.

[b]【December 27, 2023 Update】[/b]
[list]
[*]Some achievements obtained by defeating bosses may not be acquired.
[/list]

[h3]■ --------------------------------------[/h3]

[h3]■ Fixed Issues --------------------------[/h3]
The following issues have been addressed and fixed:

[b]【July 18, 2024 Update】[/b]
[list]
[*]When climbing the stairs, the loaded map may sometimes be incorrect.
[/list]

[b]【July 3, 2024 Update】[/b]
[list]
[*]After loading the data again after going up the stairs, the mental strength reverts to the value before the decrease.
[*]Some cards disappear from the deck due to the effects of "Quick Work" and "Samsara".
[/list]

[b]【December 27, 2023 Update】[/b]
[list]
[*]The animation for acquiring feats after defeating a boss was not being displayed.
[*]When the language is set to Korean, the boss's text font was not displaying correctly.
[*]Achievements were not compatible with the Korean language.
[/list]

[b]【December 21, 2023 Update】[/b]
[list]
[*]Occasionally, becoming incapacitated after leveling up following an action that does not consume a turn, such as "Rapid Shot."
[*]When using "Luck" without consuming a turn, rapidly pressing buttons may cause abnormalities in the display of the hand.
[*]When using "Rapid Shot" without consuming a turn, the effect of "Will" may not activate.
[*]The volume settings are not consistently applied to some sound effects.
[*]In the mutation list, an extra "???" entry is being displayed.
[/list]

[b]【August 8, 2023 Update】[/b]
[list]
[*]When using "Rapid Fire" or "Supreme Speed" with increased range, shots may not hit enemies.
[*]Becoming incapacitated when progressing with a total card count less than the redraw count while having increased range.
[/list]

[b]【August 7, 2023 Update】[/b]
[list]
[*]The visual effect of "Power Supply" does not match its actual effect.
[*]Camera positioning for character display may shift.
[*]Cards may be discarded even without using "Almsgiving."
[*]Fluctuations in meat recovery amounts may not be reflected in the display.
[/list]

[b]【August 5, 2023 Update】[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusting the volume settings in the options may cause the SE (sound effect) from the adjustment to continue playing during gameplay.
[*]The window size maximizes every time returning to the title screen.
[/list]

[b]【August 3, 2023 Update】[/b]
[list]
[*]"Penetrating Arrow" and "Piercing Shot" may not hit enemies.
[*]Tutorial messages may not disappear as intended.
[*]The effect of "Cruelty" may fail to activate.
[/list]

[b]【July 29, 2023 Update】[/b]
[list]
[*]Occasional freezing occurs upon reaching level up at Floor 30.
[*]Character names are incorrect in certain event dialogues.
[*]Card images obtained upon leveling up may not be displayed correctly.
[*]Becoming incapacitated after acquiring mutations in events.
[*]Being unable to exit a room due to defeated enemies.
[/list][h3]■ --------------------------------------[/h3]

I apologize for any inconvenience caused to all of our players.
I kindly ask for your continued support for "Lazriel: The Demon's Fall." Thank you.

notes.title: Video Streaming and Posting Guidelines
notes.content:
This is a set of guidelines for posting and streaming gameplay videos.

I generally welcome Let's Play videos as long as they do not violate the following prohibitions. You are free to monetize your videos.

■ Prohibited Actions -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
※ If we discover any violations, I may request the removal of the videos and take appropriate actions.
※ If you, as a viewer, come across any violations, we kindly request you to report them to us.
[list]
[*] Any actions that violate the laws of respective countries.
[*] Infringement of the intellectual property rights of creators or others.
[*] Posting videos containing defamation, slander, or commentary-focused content, as well as text-only videos.
[*] Posting gameplay videos of modified or illegally obtained games.
[*] Broadcasting content that goes against public order and morals outside the game's context.
[*] Actions that breach the guidelines set by various streaming platforms.
[/list]
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Additionally, we have prepared logos and other materials necessary for creating thumbnails. You can download and use them from the following URL:

[url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1KBwuzxJcJKJ47VDBf9sg3QWAjUT7Lmy8?usp=drive_link]Press Kit (Google Drive)[/url]


Moving forward, we have a few requests for all of you:

[list]
[*] When streaming, please include a link to the store page (https://store.steampowered.com/app/1807260/).

[*] If you enjoy the game, we kindly ask you to leave a review.
※ You can write a review from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1807260/]the store page[/url].

[*] For videos containing story elements, please consider adding a warning for potential spoilers to be considerate to your viewers.
[/list]

I would be thrilled to receive your support in reaching as many people as possible with "Lazriel: The Demon's Fall."


※ Please note that these guidelines are subject to change or addition without prior notice. Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Release Commencement and Commemorative Sale Notice
notes.content:
I'm pleased to announce that on July 28, 2023, "Lazriel: The Demon's Fall," a game that combines deck-building elements with dark roguelike features, has been released!

In this game, a fallen angel ventures up a tower before succumbing to the power of demons, all while striving to return to the heavens.

To celebrate the release, we are offering a special commemorative sale where you can purchase the game at a 10% discount during the first week of its release.

Additionally, in honor of the release, we are introducing the "OTAKESAN GAME BUNDLE." This bundle allows you to acquire both "SPACE STORESHIP" and "Lazriel: The Demon's Fall," games created by OTAKESAN, at a discounted price. We highly recommend taking advantage of this bundle offer.

Furthermore, please note that the Nintendo Switch version of this game is scheduled to be released by Wakuwaku Games, and future updates will include support for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English languages.
